//: Type-checks the static explorer's browser client (src/web/static-explorer). It uses the DOM (document/window/SVG), so it needs the DOM lib the Node build (tsconfig.node.json) deliberately omits. Kept separate from tsconfig.node.json, which excludes all of src/web. `npm run typecheck` runs both.
